title: A smaller lake in a larger landscape
text: Doodh Talai sits close to Lake Pichola, but its smaller scale gives it a different setting. Nearby gardens and hills connect views of the water with views over the city. Its name is often translated as milk pond; stories explaining that name belong to local lore rather than a securely documented single origin.
